name: Dirt Bike
description: A two-wheeled motorcycle designed and manufactured for off-road use only that doesn't meet federal motor vehicle safety standards or EPA on-road emissions standards, such as an off-road e-moto. Defined by N.J.S.A. 39:3C-1 and regulated with snowmobiles and all-terrain vehicles under N.J.S.A. 39:3C.
restrictions: Two wheels, designed and manufactured for off-road use only, and not compliant with federal motor vehicle safety standards or EPA on-road emissions standards
Registered with the Motor Vehicle Commission to ride on public lands or waters or to cross a public highway
The rider must carry proof of liability insurance and current registration
Riders must be 14 or older on public lands or waters or crossing a public highway
Riders under 18 must complete an approved safety course and carry the certificate while riding
Banned from all New Jersey state parks and forests
